_comment: Kafka topic config for the durable buffer between forwarders and Splunk indexers described in learn5 Ch 3 (log pipeline architecture). retention.ms is set to survive a multi-hour indexer outage without dropping events (Ch 3 Scenario B).

consumer_groups.name: splunk-indexer-consumers
consumer_groups._note: Consumer lag monitoring is the fix for the Ch 3 anti-pattern 'no monitoring of buffer lag' — a growing lag here means the buffer is silently falling behind the indexer, well before its 24h retention window would actually lose data.
